Adams Express Company Boosted Its Stake in Signature Bank (SBNY) as Share Price Declined; Anchorage Capital Group Increases Stake in Lyondellbasell Industries N (LYB)
June 18, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Anchorage Capital Group Llc increased its stake in Lyondellbasell Industries N (LYB) by 63% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Anchorage Capital Group Llc bought 565,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.94% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 1.46 million shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $154.48M, up from 896,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Anchorage Capital Group Llc who had been investing in Lyondellbasell Industries N for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $45.09 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.02% or $1.17 during the last trading session, reaching $115.32. About 3.49M shares traded or 45.34% up from the average. LyondellBasell Industries N.V. (NYSE:LYB) has risen 41.02% since June 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.45% the S&P500. Adams Express Company increased its stake in Signature Bank (SBNY) by 38.9% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Adams Express Company bought 36,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.57% with the market. The institutional investor held 128,900 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $18.30M, up from 92,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Adams Express Company who had been investing in Signature Bank for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.78 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.18% or $0.23 during the last trading session, reaching $126.29. About 733,818 shares traded or 54.40% up from the average. Signature Bank (NASDAQ:SBNY) has declined 9.96% since June 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.53% the S&P500.
Adams Express Company, which manages about $1.83 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Pepsico Inc. (NYSE:PEP) by 96,000 shares to 134,400 shares, valued at $14.67 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Boeing Company (NYSE:BA) by 13,500 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 101,200 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL).
More news for Signature Bank (NASDAQ:SBNY) were recently published by: 247Wallst.com , which released: “Top Analyst Upgrades and Downgrades: Applied Materials, Comcast, HUYA, Sprint, Time Warner, Yelp and More” on June 13, 2018. Businesswire.com ‘s article titled: “Signature Bank to Present at the 2018 Morgan Stanley Financials Conference” and published on June 11, 2018 is yet another important article.
Among 24 analysts covering Signature Bank ( NASDAQ:SBNY ), 18 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 75% are positive. Signature Bank had 77 analyst reports since July 22, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Wednesday, October 11 the stock rating was maintained by Barclays Capital with “Overweight”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, September 2 by Zacks. The stock of Signature Bank (NASDAQ:SBNY) has “Outperform” rating given on Thursday, April 6 by Raymond James. The rating was maintained by Barclays Capital with “Equal-Weight” on Friday, October 9. Keefe Bruyette & Woods maintained the shares of SBNY in report on Thursday, January 18 with “Buy” rating. FBR Capital maintained the shares of SBNY in report on Thursday, July 21 with “Outperform” rating. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, October 3 by BMO Capital Markets. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Monday, December 18 by BMO Capital Markets. Piper Jaffray maintained the shares of SBNY in report on Thursday, January 18 with “Hold” rating. The rating was maintained by Keefe Bruyette & Woods with “Buy” on Monday, June 5.
Anchorage Capital Group Llc, which manages about $16.82 billion and $2.77 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Walmart Inc (Call) (NYSE:WMT) by 500,000 shares to 3.00M shares, valued at $266.91M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Xpo Logistics Inc (NYSE:XPO) by 353,415 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 1.53M shares, and cut its stake in Express Scripts Hldg Co (Call) (NASDAQ:ESRX).
